note: The landlord switches to Mandarin; quotes stay in Mandarin and are checked by character.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling for a renter about the apartment at 4800 Yonge Street. Is it still available?

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: Hello? Yes... sorry, my English is not good. 我可以说中文吗？

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 当然可以。请问这套公寓还在出租吗？

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: 还在。房租两千六，比网上写的多一点。

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 好的。可以养宠物吗？有停车位吗？

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: 不能养宠物。车位一个月一百五，如果你需要的话。
